dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: Hello there!

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: I'm Harry of the Knights of Favonius. This area has been deemed highly dangerous, and I have been ordered to keep the public away.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: Vicious monsters have been reported around the Stormbearer Mountains.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: We have yet to ascertain their precise location, but the Knights of Favonius are on their trail.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't see any other knights here except you...

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: We need to confirm the monsters' positions before taking large-scale action. Otherwise, they'll see us coming and run off.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: Hence, the search team is operating in smaller units. They are operating very discreetly and staying away from the public eye.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: Please, for your safety, stay away from the Stormbearer Mountains.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of help do you provide?

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: For regular citizens, I help escort them safely to the city, to Springvale, or wherever.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: For people who know how to look after themselves, adventurers and the like, I offer training in self-defense.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: Seem like you fall into the latter category. So please take this sword, and take care of yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: Oh! hi!

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: Do you need a hand with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: I'm Harry from the Knights of Favonius.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: I have been posted here by the Knights to help victims of the attack.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: I am gathering information on where monsters are stationed along this road. It'll help me better protect the merchants' route.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: If the situation gets worse, intel like this will help me convince the Acting Grand Master that the Stormbearer Mountains area is in dire need of a cleanup operation!

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: Just like the Grand Master's one, back in the day!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Harry
dialogues.text: What? You're leaving already?
